featureThai: ตั้งค่าเวลารอบจัดส่ง (Pool)
inputMode: Mixed (Existing Prototype + Existing Screen Flow + Existing UI/hi-fi)
note: This is the first canonical registry for this feature. Screen IDs below are newly established (no prior machine-readable registry existed) and are now the fixed contract going forward — do not renumber in future passes.

sources.note: Self-unpacking bundled HTML; explored via browser automation in the prior UX pass (screenshot / accessibility tree / DOM). Not re-explored in this pass; carried forward as evidence per task instruction.
Prior UX pass, PO-reviewed 2026-09-28/29. All PO Decisions in it are treated as DECISION here, not re-litigated.

Covers 8 of the old doc's screens/states (old S1,S2,S3,S4,S4-error,S5,S6,S7,S8 = 9 files). Predates the new registry naming — mapped to new IDs in each screen's prototypeReference. Does NOT cover the Create-Pool sub-flow (new S2).

screens.name: แก้ไขข้อมูล Pool
screens.purpose: Single screen to edit one Pool's basic data plus view/manage its full list of configured delivery-appointment time slots.
entry: From L1 (page-load routing) when a Pool record already exists
From S2.SUCCESS after a new Pool is created (lands here with zero time slots)
Return target after closing S3/S4 modals
exit: S3 (เพิ่มเวลารอบจัดส่ง) via เพิ่มเวลารอบนัดหมาย
S4 (แก้ไขเวลารอบจัดส่ง) via row แก้ไข
S1.CONFIRMATION via page-level บันทึก
Out of scope: ย้อนกลับ → Pool List screen (not part of this feature)

states.name: มีข้อมูล (populated table)
states.description: Table has >=1 time-slot rows (observed: 10 rows for Pool P0230). KPI summary card shows live-computed values.

states.name: ไม่มี Time Slot (zero rows)
states.evidence: OBSERVED (SRC-PROTOTYPE demo toggle) + DECISION (also the landing state after S2.SUCCESS)
states.description: Same form/layout as S1.DEFAULT; table region replaced by centered message "ยังไม่มีข้อมูลเวลารอบจัดส่งสำหรับ Pool นี้"; KPI tiles all 0; no filter button; เพิ่มเวลารอบนัดหมาย stays enabled.
states.note: Old hi-fi filename says 'S2' — that was the old numbering's screen id, not this registry's. It is state EMPTY of this registry's S1.

states.name: ตัวกรอง expanded (inline)
states.description: Filter panel renders inline below the toolbar, pushing the table down (not a modal). Fields: ช่องทางการขาย, Delivery Option, Slot Type. Buttons: ล้าง / ใช้ตัวกรอง. DECISION: re-clicking ตัวกรอง only collapses the panel; only ใช้ตัวกรอง applies values to the table.

states.name: ยืนยันการเปลี่ยนแปลงข้อมูล (page-level Save)
states.evidence: OBSERVED (SRC-PROTOTYPE, SRC-SCREENFLOW-OLD old-S8) — modeled as a State/dialog of S1, not a separate Screen, per this registry's Screen-vs-Logic-Node/modal rules
states.description: Triggered by footer บันทึก. Warning icon + heading + confirm body text + ยกเลิก/ยืนยันบันทึก. DECISION: no success toast after ยืนยันบันทึก (confirmed intentional).

interactions.name: แถว สถานะ (เปิด/ปิด) toggle
interactions.description: Flips immediately in place, no confirmation. Summary KPIs recompute live. DECISION: toggling ปิด→เปิด (activate) shows a success toast; ปิด→เปิด needs none, no toast on ปิด.

interactions.name: แถว ลบ action
interactions.evidence: DECISION (hard-delete rejected) + DECISION REQUIRED (scope of remaining affordance)
interactions.description: Prototype behaviour (immediate hard delete, no confirm) is REJECTED — deleting a slot breaks Report data that references it. DECISION: replace with the existing สถานะ toggle as the deactivation path. DECISION REQUIRED (DR-01): remove the ลบ icon from the table entirely, vs keep it but restrict to slots with zero historical usage.
interactions.prototypeNote: Shows the 'remove entirely' default option. The 'restrict to zero-usage' alternative has no artboard yet — blocked on DR-01.

interactions.name: Clipboard-write side effect on เพิ่มเวลารอบนัดหมาย click
interactions.description: Not a UX concern; confirmed prototype debug leftover. Flagged for engineering to strip out; must not be replicated in the real build.

screens.name: สร้าง Pool ใหม่
screens.purpose: Entry into and completion of creating a brand-new Pool record when none exists yet for this context. New requirement (2026-09-29), no prototype reference at all.
entry: From L1 (page-load routing) when no Pool record exists yet

states.name: ไม่มีข้อมูล Pool (entry / call-to-action)
states.evidence: PROPOSED (INFERRED from SRC-SCREENFLOW-OLD old-S2, DECISION that this flow exists at all is confirmed by PO 2026-09-29; the exact CTA label/visual is PROPOSED)
states.description: Page-level empty state: no Pool data to show at all (distinct from S1.EMPTY, which has a Pool but zero time slots). Single CTA leading to S2.FORM.

states.name: กรอกข้อมูล Pool ใหม่
states.evidence: DECISION (flow exists, PO-confirmed 2026-09-29) + DECISION REQUIRED (DR-02a: exact field list)
states.description: Form to enter new Pool data before first save. Known fields (by analogy to S1's ข้อมูล Pool card): ชื่อ Pool (ภาษาไทย) *, ชื่อ Pool (ภาษาอังกฤษ) *, รหัส Pool *, สถานะการใช้งาน *. DECISION REQUIRED (DR-02a): is รหัส Pool system-generated (read-only/auto) or user-entered? S1 only ever shows it read-only in an EDIT context (existing Pool P0230) — never observed in a CREATE context. Do not assume either answer.

states.name: บันทึกข้อมูล Pool · Save Confirm Dialog
states.evidence: DECISION (flow exists) — modeled as a State/dialog of S2, not a separate Screen, reusing the S1.CONFIRMATION dialog component anatomy
states.description: Same pattern family as S1.CONFIRMATION — confirm before creating the new Pool record. ยกเลิก returns to S2.FORM unchanged; ยืนยันบันทึก proceeds to S2.SUCCESS.
states.prototypeNote: Content (heading/body text) differs from S1's save-confirm — reuses the same dialog component anatomy/tokens, new copy only.

states.name: บันทึกสำเร็จ · Pool Created
states.evidence: DECISION REQUIRED (DR-02b) — existence of a success step is in PO's diagram, but its presentation is unresolved
states.description: Confirms the new Pool was created. DECISION REQUIRED (DR-02b): is this a dedicated success screen/state the user must acknowledge, or a toast + immediate redirect to S1.EMPTY? Do not design final visuals until resolved — do not invent either answer.

screens.name: เพิ่มเวลารอบจัดส่ง
screens.purpose: Create a new time-slot row for the current Pool. Kept as its own Screen (not downgraded to a State of S1) because: 11-field form, its own validation/error state machine shared via Logic Node L2, and independently complete hi-fi coverage as a self-contained artboard — materially more complex than a simple confirm/toast overlay.
entry: From S1 (either DEFAULT or EMPTY state) via เพิ่มเวลารอบนัดหมาย
exit: ปิด → back to S1, no change
บันทึก → L2 (validation gate)

states.name: Default (empty form)
states.description: Fields: ช่องทางการจัดส่ง*, Slot Type (VIP checkbox), ช่องทางการขาย, Truck Turn*, เวลาเริ่มต้น*, เวลาสิ้นสุด*, Duration, Capacity, Cut Off Time*, เวลาโหลดเริ่มต้น*, เวลาโหลดสิ้นสุด*. Footer: ปิด / บันทึก.

states.name: Validation / overlap error
states.evidence: DECISION (SRC-SCREENFLOW-OLD PO decision #2) — prototype itself showed no error UI (silently closed on empty required fields); this state is required by the confirmed validation rule, not observed
states.description: Shown when L2 fails: overlap on Slot Time and/or Load Time against existing slots, or required fields empty. Inline per-field error + banner, submit blocked.

screens.name: แก้ไขเวลารอบจัดส่ง
screens.purpose: Edit an existing time-slot row. Same field set/layout as S3, pre-filled. Kept as its own Screen for the same reason as S3.
entry: From S1 table row แก้ไข icon
exit: ปิด → back to S1, no change
บันทึก → L2 (validation gate)

states.name: Default (pre-filled)
states.description: Same fields as S3.DEFAULT, pre-filled with the selected row's current values.

states.name: Validation / overlap error
states.evidence: INFERRED (same L2 gate as S3.ERROR, no prototype ref of its own)
states.description: Same rule/anatomy as S3.ERROR, applied to the edit context.
states.prototypeNote: No dedicated edit-error artboard exists; the S3.ERROR anatomy applies directly (same component, different pre-filled values) — OPTIONAL to produce a distinct artboard.

logicNodes.name: Page Load Routing
logicNodes.nameThai: มีข้อมูล Pool อยู่แล้วหรือไม่?
logicNodes.description: On page load/navigation into this feature: if a Pool record already exists for this context, route to S1.DEFAULT. If none exists, route to S2.EMPTY.
logicNodes.openQuestion: Not blocking: the exact entry mechanism (e.g. navigating from a Pool List's แก้ไข vs. เพิ่ม Pool ใหม่ action, or a route parameter) is not specified by any evidence. Needed by angular-implementer before wiring real navigation, out of scope for this UX pass.

logicNodes.name: Time Slot Validation + Overlap Check
logicNodes.evidence: DECISION (SRC-SCREENFLOW-OLD PO decision #2, per API spec)
logicNodes.description: Shared validation gate triggered by บันทึก on S3 or S4. Validates: (1) required fields non-empty, (2) submitted time range does not overlap existing slots, checked on both Slot Time (เวลาเริ่มต้น–เวลาสิ้นสุด) and Load Time (เวลาโหลดเริ่มต้น–เวลาโหลดสิ้นสุด). Pass → row created/updated on S1, dialog closes. Fail → stays on S3/S4 respectively with a visible inline error (never a silent close, which is the rejected prototype behaviour).

decisions.decision: Hard-delete of a time slot (as seen in the prototype's ลบ icon) is rejected for the real screen — it breaks Report data that references the slot. Deactivation happens via the existing สถานะ toggle instead.

On บันทึก, validate the slot's time range for overlap against existing slots on both Slot Time and Load Time, and validate required fields are non-empty. Block save with a visible inline error on conflict/empty fields — never silently close.
The Pool-level สถานะการใช้งาน toggle not responding to clicks in the prototype is a prototype limitation only. The real screen's toggle must be functional.
ย้อนกลับ having no observable effect in the standalone bundle is confirmed correct as-is; its real destination (a Pool List screen) is out of scope for this feature.
No toast after page-level Save is confirmed intentional — no change.
Toggling a row's สถานะ from ปิด→เปิด (activating a slot) must show a success toast. ปิด needs none.
Clicking ตัวกรอง again only collapses the panel; it does not itself apply/change the filter. Only ใช้ตัวกรอง applies the filter values. Confirmed correct, no change.
The clipboard-write side effect on เพิ่มเวลารอบนัดหมาย click is not a UX concern — flagged as a prototype debug leftover for engineering to strip out, not modeled as a real interaction.
Page load branches on L1 (มีข้อมูล Pool อยู่แล้วหรือไม่): yes → S1.DEFAULT (existing Pool, populated); no → S2.EMPTY (create-new-Pool flow), which after S2.SUCCESS lands on S1.EMPTY.
S1's populated-table rendering and zero-time-slot rendering are two States (DEFAULT, EMPTY) of the same Screen, not two separate Screens.
Should the ลบ icon be removed from the table entirely, or kept but restricted to slots with zero historical usage?
options: A) Remove ลบ entirely — only แก้ไข remains in row actions (this is the working default already shown in S1_INT-ROW-DELETE's hi-fi artboard)
B) Keep ลบ but restrict it to slots with zero historical usage (needs a usage-check API and a disabled/hidden-icon rule)
decisions.recommendation: A — simpler, no new API dependency, consistent with existing hi-fi default

decisions.decision: Is รหัส Pool system-generated (read-only/auto) or user-entered in the Create-Pool form? S1 only ever shows it read-only in an EDIT context (existing Pool P0230) — never observed in a CREATE context.
options: A) System-generated — field shown read-only/placeholder on S2.FORM, assigned on save
B) User-entered — field is an editable required text input with its own validation rules (format/uniqueness) that are not yet specified either
decisions.recommendation: No safe default — needs BA/API-spec confirmation before S2.FORM's field-level design is finalized

decisions.decision: Is the create-Pool 'success' step a dedicated success screen/state the user must acknowledge, or a toast + immediate redirect to S1.EMPTY?
options: A) Dedicated success state (matches PO's diagram, which models it as a distinct step) — needs its own wireframe/content
B) Toast + immediate redirect to S1.EMPTY (simpler, consistent with D-05's no-toast-on-save precedent being the exception rather than the rule for creation success)
decisions.recommendation: No safe default — PO's own diagram implies A, but this has not been explicitly confirmed as final; flagging rather than assuming

wcag.requirement: Full keyboard operability: every field, toggle, button, table row action and paginator control reachable via Tab in a logical order matching visual layout; Enter/Space activates buttons and toggles.
Row สถานะ toggle and row action icons must have accessible names that include row context (e.g. "เปิดใช้งาน รอบ 08:00-09:00"), not a bare icon with no label.
Empty-state message must be announced to screen readers when the state is entered (e.g. via a live region or focus move), not rely on visual-only change.

Filter toggle button must expose expanded/collapsed state (aria-expanded); applied-filter chip must be individually removable via keyboard with an accessible name announcing which filter it represents.
Dialog must trap focus while open, return focus to the triggering บันทึก button on close, and be announced (role=dialog + accessible name from the heading).
CTA into the create-Pool flow must have a clear, non-generic accessible name (not just an icon).
All required fields carry a programmatic required indicator (aria-required / required attr), not just a visual asterisk; labels programmatically associated to inputs.

Same dialog-focus requirements as W-S1-05. For S2.SUCCESS specifically: if implemented as a toast (pending DR-02b), it must use an assertive/polite live region so screen-reader users are notified without needing focus to move there manually.
Time-picker dropdowns must be fully keyboard-operable (open on Enter/Space, arrow-key navigation between time options, Esc to close) — not mouse-only scrolling as observed in the prototype.

Each invalid field's error must be programmatically associated to that field (aria-describedby) and the error banner/summary announced via a live region on submit failure; error must never be conveyed by border colour alone.
บันทึก / ปิด buttons must have distinguishable accessible names beyond visual position; focus order must not skip from the last field directly past both buttons.
Same as W-S3-01, applied to S4's identical time-picker controls.
On opening S4 pre-filled with a row's data, focus must move into the dialog (first field or heading), not remain on the triggering แก้ไข icon.
